verdict.rationale: Deel documents an employer-side immigration service: sponsoring work permits through your own entities or Deel's EOR entities, processing visa renewals and transfers, and letting businesses complete forms, submit documents and pay fees with in-house experts filing. H-1B appears only as one visa type in the founders track, and the evidence never addresses the US-specific employer obligations the story names. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration/lottery support, H-1B transfer documentation, LCA filing and compliance (public access file, wage obligations), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
